packageRules.description: instantlinux/nut-upsd tags are <nut version>-r<Alpine package revision> (e.g. 2.8.5-r1). Default docker versioning treats `-r1` as a fixed variant suffix and would never propose -r2 or 2.8.6-r0; regex versioning treats the revision as a build number instead.

customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned as env vars in GitHub Actions workflows (helm, kubeconform in lint.yml) via an explicit annotation comment on the line above.

Image tags pinned in an Application's valuesObject (Authelia, both democratic-csi releases), separately from the chart's targetRevision (which the argocd manager already tracks) — neither built-in manager sees a nested image.tag override, so this catches it via an explicit annotation comment.

ArgoCD's own chart version is bumped by hand via the `helm install`/`helm upgrade` command documented in argocd/README.md (see 'Upgrading ArgoCD itself') — it isn't a Kubernetes/ArgoCD Application manifest the built-in managers scan, so this catches it via an explicit annotation comment, same pattern as the Authelia one above. A PR here only updates the doc; the actual `helm upgrade` against the cluster is still a manual step by design.
